I've added this issue in the interest of ensuring goons are adequately
protected from retarded players; please post novel forms of griefing used
by players so we can look at mitigating them in the future. For example,
right now a player can join the game and go around killing everyone with no
reason. In response, I am coding a patch which will give authenticated
players the ability to round-ban non-authenticated players.

Bad: Players spamming OOC
Fix: Goons can votemute offending players
